There are, however, people trained and experienced to help if what you seek is to process physical pain, for which we provide no advice here. If what you seek, though, is psychic/emotional/mental pain (e.g. to make you stronger, help you face your pain) or distress (e.g. causing you distress without any purposeful intent is a violation in itself). In either case, be prepared as what follows may hurt.  (Disclaimer: what we suggest below is not safe to execute without training)

* Start slowly and gently apply light pressure with your nail or a pen/pencil lead/pin prick your own fingernail or pen/pencil lead onto your skin. (Reapply each second if the initial pressure is too intense) (Safest: draw a symbol on paper) * Gently bite yourself (causing mild pain) * Press harder a pencil eraser onto yourself (causing moderate pain) * Press yourself against a harder object
